description: This file contains utility functions for converting matplotlib figures to images, preparing videos, creating image grids, and converting tensor formats, specifically tailored for tensorboard visualization in PyTorch projects.

methods.name: figure_to_image
methods.description: Converts matplotlib figures to numpy image arrays in CHW format.

methods.name: _prepare_video
methods.description: Converts a 5D tensor into a 4D tensor suitable for visualization, with padding to power-of-two batch sizes.

methods.name: make_grid
methods.description: Creates a grid of images from a batch of images for visualization.

methods.name: convert_to_HWC
methods.description: Converts tensor formats to HWC (height, width, channels) format, optionally applying grid and channel adjustments.
